messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for `billing.metering.noisy_counts` - spike and count drift observed
oncall-rita: acknowledged — I'm on it. severity? customer visible?
sre-alex: looking. pulling recent aggregator logs, doing quick `curl` to ingest-check endpoint
sre-alex: ```
$ curl -s https://internal-metrics/ingest/status
{ "window_ms": 60000, "lag_ms": 12500, "emit_rate": "burst" }
``` 
sre-alex: kv-cache backlog + retry storms in emitter (consumer lag ~ 12s) :eyes:
billing-ops: seeing delayed usage batches and ~4k overage flags queued in alert queue
support-maya: ticket #7892 from AcmeCorp reporting unexpected spike in last-billing; opened at 12:03
product-lina: customer-impact estimate? which customers hit SLA/overage thresholds
oncall-rita: AcmeCorp and 2 mid-market customers flagged. I'm templating customer notif draft :pencil:
eng-jordan: quick mitigation: flip `emit-backpressure` -> on for 1 region, and force-failfast aggregator v2
eng-jordan: `kubectl -n billing set env deploy/aggregator EMIT_BACKPRESSURE=true` (running now)
sre-alex: running replay-sanitizer to drop known duplicate traces, starting backfill job id `bf-2100` — ETA 35m
billing-ops: suppression applied to notifier queue to avoid cascading overages :thumbsup:
support-maya: notified AcmeCorp via status page and created shared doc https://rwd/ops/2100123456
oncall-rita: monitoring; will escalate to infra if lag > 30s or error rate > 0.5%
incident-bot: update: ticket routed to SRE oncall rita, severity P2
sre-alex: after mitigation emit lag down to 2.1s, dup rate dropping — logs: `dup_detected: 3.2%`
billing-ops: verifying reconciler counts; snapshot diff down from +18k to +1.2k
support-maya: keeping customer channel open, shared ETA for full reconciliation 1h
oncall-rita: thanks team. postmortem owner @sre-alex, follow-up: improve emitter backoff and add quick-toggle runbook
product-lina: noted impact for billing team; will draft customer comms for tomorrow
eng-jordan: saving commands in runbook and adding smoke check `curl /ingest/status` to alert playbook
incident-bot: incident closed to monitoring at 2100123720 - follow up checklist created
